scope: C627 source-faithful rule preparation only; no Current source, schema, runtime, instance migration, journal, or projection change.
operator_decisions: A Step RUNS exactly one Action, RUNS exactly one Workflow, or CONTAINS one or more Substeps.
RUNS is the canonical rename of RUN.
A Step owns selection and bindings. Binding values may come from a previous Step output, enclosing Workflow Run input, or fixed Step values.
Called Workflow inputs use the same three sources.
A Substep remains exactly one Action.

drafts.reason: The parameter-binding rule needs a new Summary; no existing ID is renamed or repurposed.
